intent: add /lista (shopping + todos) with tick-to-include into purchase notes
context: SvelteKit + Supabase pub-management app. New tab in More menu combining shopping list + todos. Tapping a todo deletes it; in /compras/nova, ticking shopping items concatenates them by comma into the purchase notes and removes them on save.

body: Single `tasks` table with `kind` enum ('todo'|'shopping') instead of two tables. Both share the same shape (description + created_at) and lifecycle (delete on tick), so one table with a kind discriminator is simpler and lets the store derive both lists from one query.

alternatives.reason_rejected: more schema, no shared queries needed, but duplicates RLS/migration boilerplate

alternatives.option: single `notes` table with type field for any future kind

body: Tap-anywhere-to-delete instead of explicit checkbox+confirm. The /lista page renders each item as a button that deletes on click; both shopping and todos behave the same way outside the purchase flow. Matches the user's spec ("ao tickar, pode deletar mesmo") and avoids two-step interactions on a phone-first UI.

alternatives.reason_rejected: more affordances but extra gesture surface

alternatives.option: checkbox that strikes through, separate trash button
alternatives.reason_rejected: keeps history visible but conflicts with the 'pending na rua' framing

body: Ticked shopping items concatenate by comma into the purchase notes (with manual notes appended at the end if present). Final notes string is computed via $derived.by and previewed inline ("Será salvo como: ..."). Tasks are deleted only after `purchases.add` succeeds, in /compras/nova on save.

alternatives.reason_rejected: more readable but pads the notes column awkwardly given short descriptions

alternatives.option: comma + hide manual notes input when items are picked
alternatives.reason_rejected: removes flexibility for adding extra detail like quantities

body: Place /lista in the BottomNav "Mais" overflow menu rather than promoting it to the 4 fixed tabs (Noite/Escala/Consumo/Pagar). The 4 main tabs are operational hot paths used during a shift; /lista is administrative ("o que tem na rua") and pairs naturally with /compras and /cardapio in More.

Sessão de implementação splittada em 3 commits + 1 chore via edição incremental do DataLoader.svelte (única arquivo multi-feature): payments+pix (4a62bcb), events (c496e11), lista/tasks (4dbdabe), gitignore .temp (82f2695). Migration 20260514000001_tasks.sql aplicada no Supabase remoto antes do commit. Build limpo (3 erros pre-existentes em rotas dinâmicas, não tocados).

outcome_note: /lista shipped: shopping + todos with tap-to-delete; /compras/nova picks shopping items into notes (comma-joined) and removes them on save. Migration applied to remote Supabase, 3 feat commits + 1 chore commit pushed to origin/main.
